snippet.title: False Feed – Official Trailer | Out Now on Steam
snippet.description:
Compare four surveillance feeds and find the one that contradicts the other three. Pause, rewind, and examine the same event from different perspectives in this deduction game. Work through 18 recordings across six work sites at your own pace.

■ Release date: November 5, 2026
■ Price: US$4.99
■ Platform: PC (Windows) / Steam
■ Languages: 10, including English and Japanese

▼ Wishlist on Steam
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5380560/

▼ Press & Creator Kit
https://katarienumono.com/false-feed-press-kit-en/

You are welcome to livestream False Feed, upload gameplay videos, and share screenshots of the game.

Developer / Publisher: Katarienumono, Inc.

#FalseFeed #IndieGame #PuzzleGame
